messages.content: Hi, this is your Northline Care weekly check-in. Hope you're doing alright out there. Go ahead and take your blood pressure whenever you're ready and I'll log it for you.
Been trying for the last hour but my cuff just keeps flashing ERR. Can't get a single reading.

Sorry you're dealing with that. Device troubleshooting is one of the things I'm not set up to help with — you'd want to reach out to the manufacturer or check with wherever you got the cuff. Aside from that, how have you been feeling this week? Any changes with your medications?
Had a pretty bad headache going on two days now. Took my lisinopril this morning same as always.

Thanks for letting me know — I've logged your lisinopril for today. A headache that's been hanging around for two days is something our nursing team should take a look at, especially since I don't have a reading from you today. I'm flagging this for them now. Median response time is currently 31 hours, so expect a call or message from them.
31 hours feels like a lot. It's probably nothing serious, I just figured I'd mention it.

I hear you, and it may well turn out to be minor — but that's exactly the kind of call the nurse is there to make, not me. They'll follow up directly and can go from there. I'll schedule your next regular check-in for next week. Take care of yourself.

theme: blood pressure cuff shows ERR, device support
